gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-armenian: Noto Serif Armenian has big open counters and a gentle stroke contrast. Under Autour One, whose round letters keep a single unmodulated line, a longer passage would settle into a traditional, authoritative rhythm.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-balinese: Expressive and bold, Autour One draws every curve like a rolling-ball pen. Noto Serif Balinese follows with tall, editorial lowercase and slightly thinner joins, so a longer passage reads in a steady, traditional voice.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-bengali: Noto Serif Bengali reads refined and editorial, with slightly thinner hairlines and trimmed-looking ascenders over a dense band of letters, against Autour One's uniform bold strokes. Long text feels tidy.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-devanaga: Noto Serif Devanagari is classic and literary, with short ascenders and a big lowercase body. Autour One keeps one steady pen pressure in its heading, while the text face shows a measured weight difference like thread against yarn.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-dives-ak: Autour One bends its strokes like a paperclip, bold and expressive, with a clear channel into each round letter. And Noto Serif Dives Akuru answers with refined, soft curves and short-looking capitals among tall small letters.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-dogra: Chunky headline, bookish text. Autour One holds one constant pen width throughout, with a minimal step from capitals to lowercase, and Noto Serif Dogra adds a mellow range of stroke weights, its capitals only slightly taller than the lowercase.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-ethiopic: Autour One makes round letters with walls as heavy as its straight ones. Its strongest trait is the way it sits against Noto Serif Ethiopic, whose words form solid blocks with lightly engraved, brass-like contrast.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-georgian: Authoritative and literary, Noto Serif Georgian sets tightly coiled lowercase beside Autour One. Their strongest quality is the gap between a fixed-width nib look up top and a modest, noticeable thick-thin shift below.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-gujarati: Noto Serif Gujarati brings oversized e and a counters and joins that ease only slightly in weight. Its strongest quality is the letterpress-slug mildness it sets against Autour One, whose curves never thin at all.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-gurmukhi: Editorial and literary, Autour One draws a monoline heading with a clear channel into every round letter. Noto Serif Gurmukhi has a generous x-height and a faint upstroke-downstroke difference, so a longer passage moves along smoothly.
